_measurement_note: B415/B416: measured with a throwaway clean venv (rm -rf .venv && python3.12 -m venv .venv && pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install -e ".[test]"), NOT this checkout's own .venv, which predates B355 and still carries an undeclared torch/sentence-transformers/transformers (see scripts/check_env_drift.py). assert_environment_clean() in kpi_monitor.py would refuse to run against a drifted environment; this file is proof the drift guard was satisfied at measurement time, not an assertion.

methodology.current_process_rss_mb: psutil (or ru_maxrss fallback) on this script's own process, in-process, 1 sample.
methodology.import_only_rss_mb: subprocess: RSS sampled immediately after `import campy.brain_daemon`, no model invoked, cold, 1 sample.
methodology.warm_invoked_rss_mb: subprocess: RSS sampled after spaCy (en_core_web_md) loaded AND run on a sentence, then fastembed loaded AND run on a sentence -- warm, models invoked, cold process, 1 sample. See warm_invoked_breakdown for the staged figures.
methodology.write_burst_peak_spike_mb: in-process: 5000 real graph writes (with 384-dim embeddings) against an in-memory OxigraphClient, RSS sampled every 5ms on a background thread throughout; spike = peak observed RSS - pre-burst RSS.
methodology.allocation_delta_per_100_turns_mb: in-process: gc.collect() + RSS sample, allocate 100 dummy turn dicts, gc.collect() + RSS sample again; delta scaled to a per-100-turns rate.

methodology.retrieval_compilation_latency_ms: in-process: real compile_bundle() call against an in-memory (empty) OxigraphClient, real fastembed query-embedding invocation, 5 samples (4 warm after 1 cold). Empty-graph caveat: measures stage-machinery + embedding overhead, not I/O cost against production-scale data.
methodology.graph_hop_latency_2hops_ms: in-process: real SPARQL query timed via time.perf_counter() (no sleep) against the same empty in-memory store, 10 samples, warm mean reported (cold: 0.094ms).
methodology.llm_generation_latency_s: real, single timed chat() call against local Ollama (llama3.1:8b).
methodology.dense_supernode_degree_cap: design-time configuration constant, not a per-run measurement.

methodology.all_fields: not measured by kpi_monitor.py -- these scores come from the ask-eval harness (benchmarks/ask_eval/runner.py, B304-B307), which runs many real LLM calls against a populated daemon and takes minutes. Run it directly: `python -m benchmarks.ask_eval.runner`.

methodology.handoff_overhead_ms: in-process: real get_handoff_context() call against an in-memory (empty) OxigraphClient, 10 samples, warm mean reported (cold: 0.446ms). Empty-graph caveat: no prior session exists, so this is the lower-bound 'no handoff found' cost, not a populated cross-session handoff.
methodology.handoff_constraint_violations: no automated constraint-violation checker exists in-process; requires a scripted or manual review of a live model-handoff transcript -- see backlog/B383.md.
methodology.manual_markdown_overhead_pct: no automated constraint-violation checker exists in-process; requires a scripted or manual review of a live model-handoff transcript -- see backlog/B383.md.
